description: One-column upper/lower YACR2 Maze1 dogleg decision with source -DTODD branch order and inclusive plane occupancy checks.

pinned_source.license_note: No explicit license or redistribution grant found in inspected YACR2 source, launcher, or repository-root LICENSE/COPYING paths; no license is inferred. Ports and oracle are clean-room.

input.layout: [columns, tracks, one_based_column, bottom_track, top_track, vcv_flags[columns], occupied_cells[(tracks+2)*columns]]
input.occupancy_order: Rows 0..tracks+1, each with one-based columns 1..columns in row-major order; 0 means free and 1 means occupied.

output.meaning: Selected route branch: 1 left upper, 2 right upper, 3 left lower, 4 right lower; 0 when none is feasible.

source_semantics.branch_order: The pinned -DTODD branch sequence is left upper, right upper, left lower, right lower.
source_semantics.segment_check: Four candidate segments are checked against the existing vertical plane, endpoints included; a candidate is accepted only if the adjacent column has no VCV.
source_semantics.excluded: Path drawing, via placement, net cleanup, VCG construction, rerouting, and track insertion are outside this one-column profile.

oracle.method: Independent interval scans check the source geometry and try the four branch shapes in the pinned macro-selected order.
